name: playwright-bdd-framework-training
description: Beginner-friendly Playwright and Cucumber.js automation framework for AutomationExercise.

scripts.test:no-retries: npm run clean:allure-results && cross-env CUCUMBER_RETRIES=0 cucumber-js --config cucumber.js
scripts.test:retry: npm run clean:allure-results && cross-env CUCUMBER_RETRIES=2 cucumber-js --config cucumber.js
scripts.test:retry-demo: npm run clean:allure-results && cross-env CUCUMBER_RETRIES=2 RETRY_DEMO=true cucumber-js --config cucumber.js --tags "@retry-demo"
scripts.test:chromium: npm run clean:allure-results && cross-env BROWSER=chromium cucumber-js --config cucumber.js
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean:allure-results && cross-env BROWSER=firefox cucumber-js --config cucumber.js
scripts.test:webkit: npm run clean:allure-results && cross-env BROWSER=webkit cucumber-js --config cucumber.js
scripts.test:headed: npm run clean:allure-results && cross-env HEADLESS=false cucumber-js
scripts.test:debug: npm run clean:allure-results && cross-env DEBUG=pw:api,pw:browser* cucumber-js --fail-fast
scripts.report:allure: node scripts/clean-allure-report.js && allure generate artifacts/reports/allure-results --output artifacts/reports/allure-report
scripts.allure:share: allure generate allure-results --clean --single-file --name "Team Allure Report" -o reports/allure-share && node scripts/package-allure-report.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json config/config.js eslint.config.js cucumber.js README.md "features/**/*.js" "scripts/**/*.js" "src/**/*.js" "utils/**/*.js"
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json config/config.js eslint.config.js cucumber.js README.md "features/**/*.js" "scripts/**/*.js" "src/**/*.js" "utils/**/*.js"
